# Locatic

> Locatic is a social network for developers to discover projects and builders in their city and around the world. Anyone can browse public projects, profiles and posts. Sign in with GitHub to share your public repositories, post updates, follow builders, comment and send messages.

## Start here

- [About Locatic](https://locatic.dev/about): what Locatic is, who builds it, and answers to common questions
- [Explore](https://locatic.dev/explore): public projects, builders and posts, everywhere or by city
- [Sitemap](https://locatic.dev/sitemap.xml): every indexed city, builder and project page

## Page types

- City pages, `https://locatic.dev/c/{city-slug}`: builders, recent projects and posts in one city
- Builder profiles, `https://locatic.dev/u/{github-username}`: a builder's public projects, posts and activity
- Project pages, `https://locatic.dev/project/{github-owner}/{repo}`: a project's README, releases, posts and discussion

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://locatic.dev/privacy): what Locatic stores and the location and visibility controls builders have
- [Terms](https://locatic.dev/terms)
